csv_description: Tokamak which has supplied the data.
imas_description: Name of the experimental device to which this data is related (if relevant)
notes: Device name as string. .strip() whitespace due to data quality issue (dual use of "CMOD"and " CMOD"). Transform is identity subject to preprocessing.

csv_description: Pulse number.
imas_description: Pulse number to which this data is related (if relevant)
notes: Pulse/shot number as int.

csv_description: Time in the pulse at which the data has been taken in s.
notes: Reference slice time. Constraint: summary.time is a 0d array.

csv_description: The plasma geometrical major radius in meters, from an MHD equilibrium fit, defined as the average of the minimum and the maximum radial extent of the plasma.
imas_description: R position of the geometric axis (defined as (Rmax+Rmin) / 2 of the boundary)
notes: Geometric radius rmax-rmin/2. Value source pair. One-to-two mapping, manual transform.

csv_description: The horizontal plasma minor radius in meters from an MHD equilibrium fit.
imas_description: Minor radius of the plasma boundary (defined as (Rmax-Rmin) / 2 of the boundary)
notes: Horizontal plasma minor radius.

csv_description: The plasma elongation determined from an MHD equilibrium fit.
notes: Plasma elongation.

csv_description: Separatrix surface area from an MHD equilibrium fit in m2.
notes: Noteworthy that this is in equilibrium, not summary/global_quantities

csv_description: Direction of the ion grad-B drift. 1 is towards the X-point.
notes: This depends on the sign of the toroidal field (summary/global_quantities/b0), and the divertor configuration. All TC-26 data is lower, single-null. This quantity is derived from a function of sgn(B_t) and summary/boundary/type?

csv_description: Material of the plasma facing component in the main chamber.
imas_description: Integer identifier (enumeration index within a list). Private identifier values must be indicated by a negative index.
notes: Map to identifier

csv_description: Material of plasma facing components on the limiters.
imas_description: Integer identifier (enumeration index within a list). Private identifier values must be indicated by a negative index.
notes: Map to identifier

csv_description: The vacuum toroidal magnetic field at RGEO in T.
imas_description: Vacuum toroidal field at R0. Positive sign means anti-clockwise when viewed from above. The product R0B0 must be consistent with the b_tor_vacuum_r field of the tf IDS.
notes: Vacuum toroidal magnetic field at r0 = RGEO through summary.global_quantities.r0.value

csv_description: The plasma current in A.
imas_description: Total plasma current (toroidal component). Positive sign means anti-clockwise when viewed from above.
notes: Total plasma current

csv_description: The plasma safety factor from the MHD equilibrium fit evaluated at the flux surface that encloses 95% of the total poloidal flux.
imas_description: q at the 95% poloidal flux surface (only positive when toroidal current and magnetic field are in same direction)
notes: Safety factor

csv_description: Line averaged electron density from a core interferometer line of sight in m-3.
Line average plasma effective charge determined from visible bremsstrahlung.
Divertor name for each tokamak.
notes: Transform is manual since handling indexed paths needs to be figured out

csv_description: The evaporated material used to cover the inside of the vessel. BOR = boronization.
imas_description: Chemical formula of the evaporated material or gas used to cover the vaccum vessel wall. NONE for no evaporation.

csv_description: Loss Power corrected for charge exchange and unconfined orbit losses in W. PLTH=PL-PFLOSS.
notes:
(TC26: Loss Power corrected for charge exchange and unconfined orbit
losses in W. PLTH=PL-PFLOSS.) ?

csv_description: Material of the plasma facing components in the divertor.
notes: Offputting that this does not live in summary. Also, is "description" an appropriate place for material?

csv_description: Core radiation from bolometry in W. For JET and AUG this comes from a tomographic reconstruction integrated to r/a=0.95. For C-Mod this comes from the inverted emissivity profile from lines of sight horizontally looking at the midplane, integrated to r/a=1.
imas_description: Radiated power from the plasma inside the Last Closed Flux Surface
notes:
(TC26: Core radiation from bolometry in W. For JET and AUG
this comes from a tomographic reconstruction integrated to r/a=0.95. For
C-Mod this comes from the inverted emissivity profile from lines of sight
horizontally looking at the midplane, integrated to r/a=1.)  Candidates are power_radiated_inside_lcfs, or power_radiated.
source: {"JET": "Tomographic reconstruction integrated to r/a=0.95", "AUG": "Tomographic reconstruction integrated to r/a=0.95", "CMOD": "Inverted emissivity profile from lines of sight horizontally looking at the midplane, integrated to r/a=1"}

csv_description: Magnetic configuration in the divertor.
notes: Is description ~ configuration?

csv_description: 1 if selected for the TC-26 high density branch scalings, 0 otherwise.
Plasma configuration. All TC-26 data is single null with the X-point at the bottom of the machine, noted as SN(B) or SN(L). (map to LSN)
notes: All TC26 rows are 11 (LSN). However this is lossy for the (B), (L) distinction, and it is unclear what that even is? Perhaps B, L can be stored in .source

csv_description: Confinement phase of the discharge at which the data is taken (LH is L-mode just before the transition).
notes: Flags other than LH occur only for AUG. Is it an acceptable loss of information? Regardless, the summary.H_mode flag is not descriptive of LH. Tentatively in h_mode flag, with .source having more complete information

csv_description: Effective mass number of the plasma fuel ions. This ranges from 1 to 3 in the database.
imas_description: Effective mass of the hydrogenic species (MH. nH+MD.nD+MT.nT)/(nH+nD+nT)

csv_description: L-H transition time in s.
notes: time.width?

csv_description: Auxilliary heating method. Options are NB, IC, EC and combinations thereof.
notes: core_source identifier. Additional source for each kind, so concatenations like NBIC -> core_source.source(0):NB and core_source.source(1):IC. Conditional one to many + dict transform… Perhaps we could have a dictionary of arrays/tuples?

csv_description: Charge exchange and unconfined orbit losses in W.
notes: power_due_to_first_orbit_loss + power_due_to_charge_exchange

csv_description: Loss Power not corrected for charge exchange and unconfined orbit losses in W.
notes: PL = PLTH + PFLOSS
